StrictDev Posting Rules

Rule 1: No Promotion

Strictly zero self-promotion is permitted anywhere on this platform under any circumstances.

Rule 2: Rate Limits

Users may post no more than once per 24 hours to prevent spam.

Rule 3: Link Restrictions

External links are prohibited in post bodies. All discussions must be self-contained.

Rule 4: AI Content

No AI generated content is permitted. Any automated text requires explicit disclosure.

Rule 5: Automation

Automated scripts and bots are strictly forbidden. All posts must be authored by humans.
